value: The Chromium projects, encompassing the open-source Chromium browser and ChromiumOS operating system, underpin Google Chrome and Google ChromeOS, respectively. This site serves as a central resource for developers, providing documentation, code, and guidelines for contributing to these projects. Chromium aims to deliver a safer, faster, and more stable web experience, while ChromiumOS focuses on providing a fast, simple, and secure computing environment for web-centric users.
